name: card-stack
title: Card Stack
description: Layered stack of cards. Swipe, arrow keys, or buttons throw the top card away and the next one rises. Loops, with a position indicator.

props.name: cards
props.type: Blade: named slots · React: children · Vue: default slot
props.description: Each named slot (Blade) or each child element (React and Vue) becomes one card, in order. The stack sizes itself to the tallest card.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the stack region. Describe the content, for example Customer testimonials.

props.name: prevLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous button.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next button.

props.name: cardLabel
props.description: Name of each card and the position text announced after every move. Accepts {index} and {total}.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the region. The card list gets the same id with a -cards suffix.

a11y: The stack is a region with aria-roledescription carousel and each card is a group named by cardLabel.
Left and Right arrow keys move back and forward anywhere inside the stack, and the stack itself is focusable.
Cards behind the top one are inert, so Tab never lands inside a hidden card.
A polite live region announces the new position after each move.
With reduced motion the cards swap instantly without the throw and rise animations.

ai.whenToUse: Showing a short set of equal-weight cards one at a time in a playful way: testimonials, feature highlights, tips, or profiles.
rules: Keep it to 3 to 7 cards with similar height
Give label a description of the content
Do not put the only copy of important actions on cards behind the top one
Use Carousel instead when people need to see several items at once

id.description: Tumpukan kartu bertingkat. Geser, tombol panah, atau tombol navigasi membuang kartu teratas lalu kartu berikutnya naik. Berputar, dengan indikator posisi.

props.cards: Setiap named slot (Blade) atau setiap elemen anak (React dan Vue) menjadi satu kartu, sesuai urutan. Tinggi tumpukan mengikuti kartu tertinggi.
props.label: Nama aksesibel region tumpukan. Jelaskan isinya, misalnya Testimoni pelanggan.
props.cardLabel: Nama setiap kartu dan teks posisi yang diumumkan setelah setiap perpindahan. Menerima {index} dan {total}.
props.id: Id region. Daftar kartu memakai id yang sama dengan akhiran -cards.

a11y: Tumpukan adalah region dengan aria-roledescription carousel dan setiap kartu adalah group yang dinamai cardLabel.
Tombol panah kiri dan kanan bergerak mundur dan maju di mana pun di dalam tumpukan, dan tumpukan itu sendiri bisa difokus.
Kartu di belakang kartu teratas bersifat inert, jadi Tab tidak pernah masuk ke kartu yang tersembunyi.
Live region polite mengumumkan posisi baru setelah setiap perpindahan.
Saat reduced motion kartu berganti seketika tanpa animasi lempar dan naik.

ai.whenToUse: Menampilkan sedikit kartu yang setara satu per satu dengan cara yang menyenangkan: testimoni, sorotan fitur, tips, atau profil.
rules: Batasi 3 sampai 7 kartu dengan tinggi yang mirip
Jangan menaruh satu-satunya aksi penting di kartu yang ada di belakang
Pakai Carousel bila orang perlu melihat beberapa item sekaligus
